on.unsupported: level 1 never offers a web tool (#1200, decision 0075): the engine's gate hook denies by name every tool outside read_file, write_file, edit_file, run_command and manage_task, and read_url_content is none of them

off.default: brokkr driver agy writes one PreToolUse hook with matcher "" into the engine's HOME, which denies by name every tool outside its list: hook-allowlist-others measured such a hook deny invoke_subagent, and gate-prior-grant the gate deny search_web while the turn went on (docs/evidence/adapters/agy-cli-1-5.md, Native tools and hooks)

restrictions.unsupported: no native transport for a restriction on Antigravity CLI's read_url_content has been established: web-search-deny-rules shows a deny rule did not stop the native web tools
